g.title: cluster_guest
g.text: Guest: inside the KVM virtual machine (ADR-0003)

g.title: cluster_host
g.text: Warpine host process (one per OS/2 process, ADR-0020)

g.title: program
g.text: OS/2 program (LX / NE) and its DLLs

g.title: thunks
g.text: API stub area at MAGIC_API_BASE: INT 3 per ordinal (ADR-0005)

g.title: vcpu
g.text: vCPUs and threads: VM exits, kicks, callbacks, exceptions, signals (ADR-0007, ADR-0023)

g.title: entry
g.text: Start-up: PM, VIO window, full screen or headless

g.title: loading
g.text: Loading and guest memory: objects, fixups, GDT / IDT, imports

g.title: vcpu->program
g.text: callbacks: window procedures, exception handlers, exit lists

g.title: children
g.text: Child Warpine processes (DosExecPgm, WinStartApp, pipes, signal exceptions)

g.title: vcpu->children
g.text: signals and DosKillProcess as real-time signals (pidfd)

g.title: kernel
g.text: Kernel APIs: DOSCALLS, QUECALLS, MSG, processes and WinStartApp (nesting limit, ADR-0028), CONFIG.SYS THREADS= session limit, IPC, named pipes (ADR-0022), timers, session clock and WARPINE.DLL 64-bit time (ADR-0039), 16-bit information segments (ADR-0040)

g.title: net_mm
g.text: Sockets and multimedia: SO32DLL / TCP32DLL, MMPM/2

g.title: textmode
g.text: Text mode: VIOCALLS, KBDCALLS, MOUCALLS, ANSI console

g.title: pmwin
g.text: PM window manager: PMWIN windows, messages, hooks (ADR-0026), input, painting, presentation parameters, atoms, DDE, dialogs embedded in windows (ADR-0042)

g.title: gpi
g.text: GPI: presentation spaces, state, transforms, drawing, fonts, bitmaps, regions, clipping, paths (ADR-0024, ADR-0027)

g.title: pmshell
g.text: PM shell DLLs: PMSHAPI profiles (ADR-0017), switch list (per process, ADR-0030), HELPMGR

g.title: stddlg
g.text: Standard dialogs and printing: PMCTLS file and font dialogs built in memory of built-in controls, PMSPL spooler and device escapes without printers (ADR-0029)

g.title: core
g.text: Loader core: Loader, SharedState, managers, constants

g.title: nls
g.text: NLS and codepages: Unicode inside (ADR-0008, ADR-0016)

g.title: vfs
g.text: Virtual file system: drives on host directories (ADR-0009)

g.title: kernel->children
g.text: DosExecPgm / WinStartApp (arguments, environment, inherited handles), named pipes

g.title: hostfs
g.text: Host file system: drive C: in $XDG_DATA_HOME/warpine/drive_c

g.title: textdisplay
g.text: Text-mode display: VIO window and full-screen text (ADR-0013)

g.title: controls
g.text: Built-in controls: statics, buttons, entry fields, MLE, list box, scroll bar, combo box, spin button, slider, value set, notebook, owner draw (ADR-0025)

g.title: desktop
g.text: PM desktop front end: surfaces, compositor, chrome, fonts (ADR-0011, ADR-0012)

g.title: tools
g.text: Build tools: lx-link, gen_api, gen_arch, gen_compat (ADR-0006, ADR-0015, ADR-0021, ADR-0033)
